scope: Government referrals and dated recognition only. Narrow claims; not a complete benefits or nonprofit inventory. Import matching verification records before copy.

records.title: Start with local benefits help
records.tier: TIER 1 government source; AUTO-INGEST RECOMMENDED for the narrow referral
records.claim: WDVA directs veterans, service members and families to county/tribal officers for federal, state and local benefit assistance. Its official page links the office locator.
records.summary: A county or tribal veterans office can help you work through benefits questions and find the right local support.
records.caveat: Ask the office which services and benefits fit your service history, family situation and Wisconsin connection. A referral does not establish eligibility.
records.action: Use WDVA's Find My CVSO/TVSO page to contact the appropriate county or tribal veterans office about your benefits questions.
records.label: Find county or tribal help
records.population: All four: SEPARATING (active component), GUARD/RESERVE, SPOUSE/FAMILY and ALREADY SEPARATED may seek the described public referral; each underlying service or benefit has separate eligibility.
records.excluded: No specific officer accreditation, service capacity or individual benefit award is certified here.
records.band: Condition-triggered need or inquiry; no fixed separation band or day-offset.
records.placement: reuse existing WI-20261016-01 route; do not duplicate card

records.title: Find accredited VA claims help
records.tier: TIER 1 government source; AUTO-INGEST RECOMMENDED for the narrow referral
records.claim: VA provides representative guidance and an accreditation search. Accredited VSO claims representation is free; accredited attorneys and claims agents may charge permitted fees. Availability and appointment are separate. Root tier 2 verified the public representative-search form without sign-in; no individual search, appointment or availability was tested.
records.summary: Find a VA-accredited representative for help with a claim or decision review. Accredited VSO representatives provide claims help free of charge; attorneys and claims agents may charge fees.
records.caveat: Check accreditation and availability before appointing someone. Membership in an organization does not by itself establish that a particular person is accredited.
records.action: Use VA's accredited-representative guidance and OGC Accreditation Search to check the representative, then contact them about availability and fees before appointing them.
records.label: Find accredited claims help
records.population: All four: SEPARATING (active component), GUARD/RESERVE, SPOUSE/FAMILY and ALREADY SEPARATED may seek the described public referral; each underlying service or benefit has separate eligibility.
records.excluded: This does not approve an individual claim, guarantee a representative is available, or make every service from a listed organization free.
records.band: Condition-triggered need or inquiry; no fixed separation band or day-offset.
records.placement: claims/help destination plus bounded existing locator copy correction

records.title: Get help finding your next job
records.tier: TIER 1 government source; AUTO-INGEST RECOMMENDED for the narrow referral
records.claim: DWD directs job seekers to local Job Centers for one-on-one support. DVOP individualized services target eligible people with specified employment barriers; LVER contacts serve employer outreach.
records.summary: A Wisconsin Job Center can help you plan a job search and connect with employment or training services.
records.caveat: Ask which services fit your situation. Specialized veteran services have eligibility rules; an appointment or referral does not guarantee a job or funding.
records.action: Use the Wisconsin Job Center directory to contact a nearby center and ask for one-on-one employment support and any veteran services that fit your situation.
records.label: Find a Job Center
records.population: All four: SEPARATING (active component), GUARD/RESERVE, SPOUSE/FAMILY and ALREADY SEPARATED may seek the described public referral; each underlying service or benefit has separate eligibility.
records.excluded: Do not promise DVOP eligibility to every veteran or send job seekers to the employer-only LVER route.
records.band: Condition-triggered need or inquiry; no fixed separation band or day-offset.
records.placement: reuse existing WI work guide; optional local help choice

records.title: Find employers recognized for veteran support
records.tier: TIER 1 government source; AUTO-INGEST RECOMMENDED for the narrow referral
records.claim: DWD operates Vets Ready, an employer-recognition initiative. The official page read today lists 2025 winners, corroborated by DWD's 2025 recipient announcement. DWD says JCW lets job seekers search jobs posted by Vets Ready employers. Root tier 2 verified the public Advanced Search filter and tagged job results without signing in. The base link does not select the filter automatically; result counts and availability are transient.
records.summary: Find current job listings from employers recognized by Wisconsin's Vets Ready initiative.
records.caveat: An award recognizes veteran support; it does not establish a current opening, job quality for every worker, hiring preference, or SkillBridge approval. Check current postings and the support that matters to you.
records.action: Open Job Center of Wisconsin Job Search, choose Advanced Search, then set Vets Ready Employers to All Vets Ready Employers and search; check each posting before applying.
records.label: Search Vets Ready employer jobs
records.population: All four: SEPARATING (active component), GUARD/RESERVE, SPOUSE/FAMILY and ALREADY SEPARATED may seek the described public referral; each underlying service or benefit has separate eligibility.
records.excluded: No employment benefit or program eligibility follows from browsing the list. No 2026 recipient list or named-company current vacancy is claimed.
records.band: Condition-triggered need or inquiry; no fixed separation band or day-offset.
records.placement: existing employer section; official directory instead of copied roster
records.expires: NONE for directory referral; individual postings expire and must be checked. The award list remains explicitly 2025 history.
records.instructions: Advanced Search → Vets Ready Employers → All Vets Ready Employers

relatedLinks.label: See the dated employer recognition list

records.title: Ask about help paying for retraining
records.tier: TIER 1 government source; AUTO-INGEST RECOMMENDED for the narrow referral
records.claim: WDVA offers a needs-based Retraining Grant route for qualifying veterans facing unemployment/underemployment. Other funding is considered; OJT support is paid to the employer. The current fact sheet names WDVA 2019 and 2039 and WDVA review.
records.summary: If a job loss or reduced work means you need retraining, ask WDVA whether its Retraining Grant fits your situation.
records.caveat: Veteran status, work history, financial need and training approval matter. Other funding is reviewed; this is not automatic extra income. OJT payments go to the employer.
records.action: Ask the WDVA Grants Unit through its Employment Grants page to review your retraining situation and the appropriate WDVA 2019 and, for OJT, WDVA 2039 forms before counting on grant support.
records.label: Check WDVA retraining help
records.population: ALREADY SEPARATED and GUARD/RESERVE only where independently qualified under WDVA veteran and program criteria; SEPARATING (active component) may plan for a later qualifying circumstance.
records.excluded: This does not apply to spouses/family by relationship alone or establish a grant for a current SkillBridge placement.
records.band: Condition-triggered need or inquiry; no fixed separation band or day-offset.
records.placement: conditional training/work-cost detail; avoid another first-screen card

records.title: Employer support for qualifying veteran hires
records.tier: TIER 1 government source; AUTO-INGEST RECOMMENDED for the narrow referral
records.claim: WDVA currently lists an ongoing Veterans Employment Grant for qualifying employers hiring qualifying veterans with a specified service-connected disability. Employer application and WDVA employee certification are separate forms.
records.summary: WDVA has an employer grant for qualifying veteran hires with a service-connected disability. The employer receives the grant.
records.caveat: The worker, employer and employment conditions must be reviewed by WDVA. This is not member cash, SkillBridge wages, or approval to combine reimbursements for the same cost.
records.action: Use WDVA Employment Grants to ask the WDVA Grants Unit about the employer application WDVA 2643 and employee certification WDVA 2642 for the proposed hire.
records.label: Check the employer grant
records.population: ALREADY SEPARATED; GUARD/RESERVE only if independently qualifying as the covered veteran; SEPARATING (active component) for future-hire planning only.
records.excluded: This does not apply to spouses/family by relationship alone or to every veteran hire; government-agency employers are excluded by the current application.
records.band: Condition-triggered need or inquiry; no fixed separation band or day-offset.

records.title: Find Wisconsin veteran-owned businesses
records.tier: TIER 1 government source; AUTO-INGEST RECOMMENDED for the narrow referral
records.claim: WDVA provides a certified veteran-owned-business directory with county and business-type filters. This is ownership certification, separate from DWD veteran-support recognition or current hiring.
records.summary: Explore WDVA's directory of certified veteran-owned businesses by county or type of business.
records.caveat: Veteran ownership does not establish a job opening, Vets Ready recognition, nonprofit status, or SkillBridge approval.
records.action: Use WDVA's certified veteran-owned-business directory to find a business by county or category and review its own website for the service or opportunity you need.
records.label: Explore veteran-owned businesses
records.population: All four: SEPARATING (active component), GUARD/RESERVE, SPOUSE/FAMILY and ALREADY SEPARATED may seek the described public referral; each underlying service or benefit has separate eligibility.
records.excluded: The directory does not certify a job vacancy or determine eligibility for a contracting preference.
records.band: Condition-triggered need or inquiry; no fixed separation band or day-offset.
records.placement: optional business ownership/networking detail; not primary job results

records.title: Explore Wisconsin state careers
records.tier: TIER 1 government source; AUTO-INGEST RECOMMENDED for the narrow referral
records.claim: DWD and WDVA identify Wisc.Jobs as the state-government job portal. DPM separately describes a non-competitive appointment route for qualifying disabled veterans, subject to conditions and vacancies.
records.summary: Explore Wisconsin state-government careers and check whether a veteran hiring route fits your situation.
records.caveat: Job requirements still apply. Veteran hiring routes have separate criteria and do not guarantee selection.
records.action: Use WDVA's State of Wisconsin Employment page to reach Wisc.Jobs and the veteran appointment instructions; ask the Division of Personnel Management about eligibility or the application process.
records.label: Explore state careers
records.population: All four: SEPARATING (active component), GUARD/RESERVE, SPOUSE/FAMILY and ALREADY SEPARATED may seek the described public referral; each underlying service or benefit has separate eligibility.
records.excluded: The ordinary careers portal is open to job seekers; a family connection or military service alone does not establish eligibility for the specialized appointment route.
records.band: Condition-triggered need or inquiry; no fixed separation band or day-offset.
records.placement: optional job-search detail; no new first-screen destination

records.title: Find housing support for your household
records.tier: TIER 1 government source; narrow program and referral only
records.claim: VA SSVF serves low-income veteran families experiencing or at imminent risk of homelessness and directs visitors to a provider list. This differs from a veteran-only residential bed or a universal grant. Root tier 2 verified that the provider link targets the official FY26 intake workbook; workbook contents and current intake capacity were not read or inferred.
records.summary: If your household is at risk of losing housing or is already without a home, VA Supportive Services for Veteran Families may be a route to housing support.
records.caveat: The provider reviews veteran-family eligibility, income, housing need, local service area and available help. This is not a guarantee of a payment or place to stay.
records.action: Open VA's Supportive Services for Veteran Families page and use its SSVF Providers link to locate an organization serving your area, then ask that provider to review your household's situation.
records.label: Find veteran-family housing support
records.population: ALREADY SEPARATED and SPOUSE/FAMILY in an eligible veteran household; GUARD/RESERVE only where independently meeting the program veteran criteria.
records.excluded: This does not establish eligibility from current military service or family relationship alone; it is not routine relocation assistance for every household.
records.band: Condition-triggered housing instability; no fixed separation offset.
records.placement: conditional housing help; pair with existing VHRP family-exclusion note, not a second generic veteran-only card
records.expires: NONE; service availability and provider eligibility must be checked

records.title: Connect with Wisconsin women veterans support
records.tier: TIER 1 government source; AUTO-INGEST RECOMMENDED for narrow referral
records.claim: WDVA maintains a Women Veterans Program with outreach, advocacy, connection resources and a named program contact.
records.summary: WDVA's Women Veterans Program offers a place to ask about support, advocacy and connections for women veterans in Wisconsin.
records.caveat: Ask the program which resources fit your needs. A referral does not establish eligibility for a benefit, event or clinical service.
records.action: Open WDVA's Women Veterans page and contact the Women Veterans Program using the published program contact to ask about resources and connections for your situation.
records.label: Connect with the Women Veterans Program
records.population: Women in ALREADY SEPARATED; women in GUARD/RESERVE with qualifying veteran status; SEPARATING (active component) may ask about transition connections.
records.excluded: This does not establish a women-veterans service or benefit for spouses/family solely through relationship; general county/tribal help remains available.
records.band: Condition-triggered support or connection inquiry; no fixed separation offset.
records.expires: NONE; current services checked with program
